sentences.en: Your son took part in the student movement, I hear.
sentences.zh: 我听说你儿子参与了学运。

sentences.en: Are your opinions representative of those of the other students?
sentences.zh: 你的意见能代表其他学生的想法吗？

sentences.en: The teacher is likely to get angry with the students.
sentences.zh: 老师可能会生这些学生的气。
